description: Lightweight situational-awareness tool that ingests local sample events and prints human-readable summaries
constraints: No databases, no networking, no ML, no frameworks, no paid APIs

tasks.name: Project Setup
tasks.description: Initialize project structure, README, and configuration files

tasks.name: Define Core Data Models
tasks.description: Create Event, Situation, and Summary data structures with type hints

tasks.name: Implement Event Loader
tasks.description: Read sample events from JSON files or stdin, validate and parse events

tasks.name: Implement Event Aggregator
tasks.description: Process events, group by situation/context, compute statistics and patterns
deliverables: src/aggregator.py (EventAggregator class with grouping, filtering, summary logic)

tasks.name: Implement Output Formatter
tasks.description: Format aggregated summaries into human-readable text, tables, or structured output

tasks.name: Implement CLI Interface
tasks.description: Wire together loader, aggregator, and formatter; create main entry point with argument parsing

tasks.name: Write Unit Tests
tasks.description: Create tests for models, loader, aggregator, and formatter modules

tasks.name: Create Sample Data and Documentation
tasks.description: Generate example event data files and write usage guide with examples

dependency_summary.critical_path: task_001 -> task_002 -> task_003 -> task_004 -> task_005 -> task_006 -> task_007 -> task_008
dependency_summary.estimated_timeline: 8 builder tasks, suitable for 2-3 development iterations
